description_zh: Zoox 沿 11 街直行，对向一辆原本路边停放的车辆完成 U 形掉头后越过双黄线侵入本车道，发生侧碰。抽象为 oncoming 车辆侵入车道场景。

source_snippets: passenger car pulled out of the parking spot and made a U-turn into the opposite travel lane, and unexpectedly crossed the double-yellow centerline and veered into the Zoox vehicle's travel lane
evidence.reason: NPC 从同向右侧路边驶出后掉头进入对向车道并越过中心线侵入 ego 车道，该交互可用 oncoming 位置与 oncoming 行为加 encroach=cross 表达。
